vibe: Apple-style, Glassmorphism, Premium Audio, Magical Enhancement

surfaces.navbar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 (dark) or bg-white/70 (light), 1px bottom border
surfaces.cards: Neumorphism mix: 1px border, soft ambient shadow, flat background, heavy corner radius (rounded-3xl)
surfaces.audio_visualizer: Crystal Glass: heavy blur, saturated background behind it to create an Apple-style vibrant blur.

interactions.record_active: pulsing radial glow, organic breathing scale
interactions.predict_active: shimmering gradient sweep across the button, scanning effect on waveform

animations.stars_effect: Use react-tsparticles or a custom canvas to render slowly drifting, very small opacity particles in the background. It should look like deep space dust or stars.

layout.grid: Control Room layout: centralized focus for the audio editor. Split panel (Input vs Output) or an overlapping bento box.
layout.spacing: Generous: p-8 to p-12 inside cards, gap-8 between elements.

components.record_button: Massive circular button. When active, glowing red/orange ring with pulsing animation.
components.file_upload: Dashed border zone with glassmorphic center. Hover to reveal drop state with Framer Motion spring expansion.
components.metrics_display: Bento box style: small square widgets for SNR and SI-SDR, using JetBrains Mono for the numbers.
components.audio_player: Custom UI. Do NOT use default `<audio controls>`. Use Shadcn sliders for timeline, custom SVG/Lucide icons for play/pause.
components.waveform: Use a library like `wavesurfer.js` or a custom canvas/SVG visualizer. Make the waveform gradient (Orange to Crimson) to contrast against the dark background.

images.description: Starry dark abstract background for the overall app wrapper. Use with low opacity or mix-blend-mode to achieve the magical stars effect.
Glassy soundwave art to be used inside the empty state of the audio player or as a decorative side image.
Black condenser mic on dark background. Good for empty state of the 'Upload/Record' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-tsparticles` and `tsparticles` for the 'stars effect' background.
Use pure Tailwind for layout; build a custom glassmorphic shell for the audio interface.
For the audio visualization, implement a custom waveform or use `wavesurfer.js`. Customize it to use a gradient matching the accent colors.
Do not use generic blue/purple UI. Stick to the 'Jewel & Luxury' Apple aesthetic (Space Black + Sunset Orange/Crimson).
The metrics (SNR, SI-SDR) MUST use JetBrains Mono or a similar monospace font.
Build a custom HTML/Tailwind audio player. Do NOT use standard <audio controls> as they break the premium vibe.
Ensure dark/light mode toggle exists in the glassy navbar. Swap colors via Tailwind 'dark:' modifier.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'record-button', 'upload-dropzone', 'predict-button').
